scientific_integrity: Two complete enumeration algorithms and entire labeled/orbit catalogs are supplied; source claims distinguish known six-word optimum from newly evaluated full class census. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification only at four symbols, source-word length three, and exactly six distinct words; no general-alphabet formula or new minimum-size bound. Historical priority awaits independent audit.
